A Birthday Letter

A little book made just for you, filled with words I wanted you to keep. 🎂💗

PAGE 1
❤️

Happy birthday to someone who has become incredibly special to me. I wanted to write this message for you because I wanted it to feel personal and meaningful. I hope it does justice to how much you mean to me, because your smile truly has a way of lighting up any room, and your energy is something I always look forward to being around.

PAGE 2
💗

I feel so lucky for the time we’ve spent together and for getting to know the amazing person you are. You are kind, beautiful, and uniquely yourself, and every conversation we share leaves me looking forward to the next. You have this effortless ability to make ordinary days feel memorable.

PAGE 3
💕

It’s been such a beautiful journey watching our connection grow, and I'm so excited about what the future holds for us. I truly hope today is just the beginning of a spectacular year ahead for you, filled with all the love, laughter, and success you deserve.

PAGE 4
💖

Thank you for just being you. I can’t wait to celebrate you today, make more wonderful memories together, and see where our story takes us next. Have the happiest of birthdays!
